title: OpenHW CORE-V MCU
_note: The CORE-V MCU: the OpenHW microcontroller built around CV32E40P -- the APB
peripheral set (GPIO, timers, the advanced timer, I2C slave, the FLL
interface, the APB node and bridges), the uDMA subsystem, the L2 / TCDM
hybrid interconnect, the eFPGA subsystem and the SoC / FC glue, plus the
vendored PULP libraries it needs.
ips_list.yml says it outright -- `No external dependencies.  Everything has
been flattened into rtl/` -- so there is NO FuseSoC / Bender / vendor step:
common_cells, axi, fpnew, fpu_div_sqrt_mvp, register_interface, riscv-dbg,
tech_cells_generic and cv32e40p are all committed under rtl/vendor.
The Makefile's generate step (generate-scripts, producing pad_control.sv,
pulp_peripheral_defines.svh, periph_bus_defines.svh) does not need to run
either: its outputs are checked in.  Verified before relying on it --
rtl/includes holds all four .svh files and rtl/core-v-mcu/top/pad_control.sv
is present in the checkout.
exclude_srcs drops two WHOLE FLAVOURS of the vendored tech_cells_generic,
and a recursive glob over rtl/ is wrong without them:
src/rtl/tc_clk.sv and src/fpga/tc_clk_xilinx.sv define THE SAME module
names -- tc_clk_mux2, tc_clk_gating, tc_clk_buffer, tc_clk_and2,
tc_clk_inverter, tc_clk_xor2, tc_sram -- so compiling both is a duplicate
definition, and the Xilinx flavour instantiates `BUFGMUX`, a Xilinx library
primitive this repository never defines.  That is what 33 rows reported as
`unknown module 'BUFGMUX'`.  src/deprecated holds a third set with the same
problem.  Each `*_xilinx.sv` is a DUPLICATE of its generic sibling:
src/fpga/tc_clk_xilinx.sv redefines src/rtl/tc_clk.sv's seven modules,
src/fpga/tc_sram_xilinx.sv redefines tc_sram, deprecated/
pulp_clk_cells_xilinx.sv redefines all six pulp_clock_* cells of
pulp_clk_cells.sv, and cluster_clk_cells_xilinx.sv redefines
cluster_clk_cells.sv's -- and also declares `pulp_clock_mux2`, colliding
with pulp_clk_cells.sv as well.  So the exclusion is exactly src/fpga plus
the `*_xilinx.sv` files, and NOT all of src/deprecated: the design really
does instantiate the GENERIC deprecated cells (pulp_clock_gating,
pulp_clock_gating_async, pulp_clock_inverter, pulp_clock_mux2), and
excluding that directory wholesale replaced one `unknown module` with four.
rtl/efpga is excluded as a SOURCE TREE, and with it the rows that cannot
elaborate without it.  Two reasons, both in the vendor's files and neither
fixable here:
* rtl/efpga/ql_fcb/rtl/fcb.sv is PROTECTED SOURCE -- it carries IEEE 1364
`protect / `endprotect markers, and Surelog stops at
`extraneous input '`protect'`.  Every closure containing it fails to
parse, which is what 18 rows reported as an error.
* eFPGA_wrapper instantiates `QL_eFPGA_ArcticPro2_32X32_GF_22_Arnold2` and
`sram512x64`, QuickLogic hard macros the repository never defines.  A
stand-in is not appropriate for either: the eFPGA core is the whole point
of the block and an invented one would be measuring a netlist built from
a shape nobody verified (the NVDLA stand-ins are LIBRARY CELLS -- assert
fifos and synchroniser flops -- which is a different thing).
That costs four structural rows -- efpga_subsystem, soc_peripherals,
soc_domain and the core_v_mcu top, each of which instantiates the subsystem
-- plus the ~45 module names defined under rtl/efpga.  The MCU's own content
is unaffected: the APB peripheral set, the uDMA subsystem, the L2 / TCDM
interconnect, the FC glue and the vendored PULP libraries all still sweep.
Three more exclusions, each measured rather than assumed:
* apb_pll, clk_gen and clk_and_control instantiate `PLL18_TOP` /
`pPLL02F`, vendor PLL hard macros the repository does not define -- the
same class SERV excludes its board tops for.
* cv32e40p_tracer and cv32e40p_apu_tracer are simulation-only, and
cv32e40p.json already excludes them in its own family.
* axi_xbar_intf does not elaborate at its defaults (the interface-based
crossbar wrapper); the PULP `axi` family sweeps it with bound types.
